title: Campus Size and Setting Explorer
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Compare typical campus experiences across twelve combinations of school size and setting, highlight your target zone, and pin the colleges on your list.

learningObjectives: Students will compare typical campus experiences across combinations of school size and setting and classify colleges they know into the matching cells.

controls: Place pin and Clear pins buttons

keyQuestions: Which 'watch for' item would matter most to you, and why?
Can a large university feel small? What would you look for?
Why is a college's setting a different question from its distance from home?
commonMisconceptions: Every small college is rural and every large university is urban.
Large universities only have huge lecture classes.
assessmentOpportunities: Students correctly place five colleges they know into the grid and describe one typical trade-off of their preferred cell.
